company.name: Sharqi Shop
company.shortDescription: Sharqi Shop is an online platform that connects artisans with creative product designers to come up with new creations that fit the market.
company.description:
Sharqi is the home for craftspeople, artisans and potters which bridges them to reveal the hidden beauty of the Middle East to the world. It gives them a chance to start, manage and scale their handmade businesses without being worried about logistics, customer service or even marketing, to allow them focus on their authentic goods and craft supplies.

Precision, uniqueness and contemporary of handmade items is what makes it original. Knowing that with every purchase, you are helping Sharqi to put back the local and international map for crafters.

All made with love and precision to fulfill the originality of you.

productsAndServices.description: An online platform connecting artisans with product designers to create market-fit products.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $28,000, or 35.9% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $393,470 to $770,722, a 1.96x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 32 (-24 over 90 days) and market heat at 40 (-2).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
